description_en: Retrieves driver configurations of an edge instance in batches
description_zh: 批量获取边缘实例驱动配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-edge-instance-driver-configs --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of driver IDs to query. On the Driver Management page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID.

You can specify up to 20 driver IDs. This means you can retrieve configurations of up to 20 drivers in a single batch
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的驱动ID列表。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取。

最多可传入20个驱动ID，即最多可批量获取20个驱动的配置
parameters.name: driver_ids

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

DriverConfigList.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
DriverConfigList.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

Content.description_en: The configuration content text or the OSS address where the configuration content file is stored
Content.description_zh: 配置内容文本或存储配置内容文件的OSS地址

Format.description_en: The format of the configuration file. Valid values: KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file)
Format.description_zh: 配置文件格式，取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）

Key.description_en: The key of the configuration. This is used to distinguish configurations when multiple configurations exist
Key.description_zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
